construct: RBM20 is a cardiac RNA-binding splicing regulator whose major targets include TTN and other sarcomeric/ion-handling transcripts. Pathogenic RBM20 dysfunction alters titin isoform splicing and can cause aggressive familial dilated cardiomyopathy with arrhythmias.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Young familial DCM with ventricular arrhythmia and an RBM20 pathogenic variant identifies a cardiac RNA-splicing disorder; RBM20 normally controls alternative splicing of TTN and other cardiac pre-mRNAs.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: DNA repair, mitochondrial transcription, proteasomal ubiquitination, and RyR calcium-channel function are different molecular layers. Some RBM20 targets affect ion handling, but RBM20 itself is an RNA splicing regulator.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The lead tests the normal molecular role, avoiding uncertainty about variant-specific gain/loss mechanisms while preserving a unique answer.
